JP Morgan: Live counterparty on the network. Its Kinexys Digital Payments platform provides the cash leg for intraday repo against HQLAx collateral, orchestrated by Ownera's FinP2P: up to $1 billion a day, $5 billion in the first month. Also a Series A investor in Ownera and a contributor to both the US and the EU/UK tokenized collateral sandboxes.
HQLAx: Live counterparty. Its DLT platform issues digital collateral receipts; ownership of collateral swaps at precise times against J.P. Morgan cash, with Ownera routing across the two ledgers. The first production flow on FinP2P.
Goldman Sachs: Named by Ownera's Open Collateral Network as coming soon on repo and collateral upgrades. Issued the first blockchain-native tokens for the LRC real estate fund on its GS DAP platform, with Ownera providing connectivity to distribution. Contributor to both collateral sandboxes.
Archax: FCA-regulated digital securities exchange, broker and custodian. Ownera's distribution partner since 2022, the custodian behind the Custodian Service and the white-label partner for the Investor SuperApp, first distribution partner for the Goldman real estate fund, and a Series A investor in Ownera. Named as coming soon on repo.
Apex Group: Global fund administrator. Partnered with Ownera in 2024 to bring distribution and servicing to tokenized assets; administers the Goldman and LRC tokenized real estate fund. Named by Ownera's Open Collateral Network as coming soon on repo.
DTCC: US central securities depository. Ownera took part in DTCC's Great Collateral Experiment, moving DTCC-held collateral to digital rails across ledgers on DTCC's AppChain; the CSD Distribution Platform SuperApp is built for that integration. Named as coming soon on repo and collateral.
LRC Group: Real estate manager of the Goldman Sachs tokenized real estate fund, distributed through Ownera and Archax. A Series A investor in Ownera; its chairman chairs Ownera's board.
US Bank: Joined Ownera's Series A in March 2026 and is named on the store as a digital cash participant of the Payment Provider Service. Contributor to the US tokenized collateral sandbox.
Fireblocks: Custody technology partner since 2021, when FinP2P first settled digital securities in USDC through Fireblocks. The 2024 partnership opened Ownera's tokenized assets to the Fireblocks Network. Listed on the LayerZero issuer hub and the custody connector.
LayerZero Labs: Cross-chain messaging partner. Two LayerZero SuperApps sit on the store: an issuer platform for deploying assets across 150+ chains and a developer connector for cross-chain messages and value transfer.
Kaiko: Digital asset market data provider. Runs the Kaiko Data Services SuperApp, the first data utility on the store, delivering prices and reference data into institutions' tokenized asset workflows. Contributor to both collateral sandboxes.
Particula: Risk ratings for tokenized assets. Launched its Risk Engine on the SuperApps platform in February 2026 after serving as prime rating provider in the GDF sandboxes.
Fnality: Wholesale digital money settlement system. The 2024 partnership lets any Router offer direct access to the Fnality Payment System for settlement and collateral flows.
Circle: Issuer of USDC. USDC has settled FinP2P digital securities transactions since 2021 via Fireblocks, is named on the Payment Provider Service, and Circle contributed to the US collateral sandbox.
BlackRock: Contributor to both tokenized collateral sandboxes powered by Ownera, testing tokenized money market funds as margin and repo collateral.
State Street: Contributor to both collateral sandboxes and named on the Collateral Mobility Manager listing as a partner.
Citi: Contributor to both collateral sandboxes, testing tokenized money market funds as institutional collateral.
Fidelity: Contributor to both collateral sandboxes; also a Kaiko data client.
Franklin Templeton: Contributor to both collateral sandboxes and named on the Collateral Mobility Manager listing. Its BENJI token standard has a plugin in Ownera's open-source EVM adapter.
Ripple: Contributor to the US tokenized collateral sandbox. The XRP Ledger is among the non-EVM chains the Universal Blockchain Connector reaches.
SWIFT: Contributor to the US tokenized collateral sandbox. Its ISO 20022 standard is the target of Ownera's ISO 20022 Compatibility Connector.
Exberry: Runs the production matching engine SuperApp: order matching, price discovery and market data for venues on the network.
ZeroBeta: Brought three BlueShift apps to the store in March 2026: Portfolio Manager, Borrowing and Lending, and Staking. Contributor to both collateral sandboxes.
Nomyx: Tokenization engine on the store since January 2026: end-to-end fund operations on-chain, with Dfns custody, Bridge fiat rails and Persona identity.
Prove: Identity provider. Three Prove products joined the store in May 2026: ProveX, Pre-Fill for Business and Know Your Payee.
Ledgible: Post-trade accounting, tax and reconciliation. Joined the store in January 2026 to receive on-chain and off-chain data from network apps.
Intain: Asset-backed finance platform, on the store since May 2026 for whole loan sales, credit facilities and securitizations.
LunarCrush: Social and market intelligence provider behind the proposed Social and Market Data SuperApp, a data utility that would deliver sentiment for 4,400+ stocks and ETFs to every Router. Not yet on the store.
